footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Lamar: after $5.9M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.7% to $2.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 67.0%, versus 67.0% a year earlier, and operating income rose 45.5% to $774M, a 34.2% margin.
Net income rose 62.3% to $587M, or $5.77 per share. Operating cash flow was $864M and free cash flow $683M, versus $748M; Lamar returned $158M through buybacks.
sources: Lamar Advertising Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
